Iris V: Quick ping 10 NebulaModels wants to list their 8B open model. They asked for hosted listing + potential SI co-demo. Main asks: can they allow downloads later, whats our default distro policy, and announcement timing?
Tom H: If downloads are allowed later, legal needs explicit redistribution language + export review. Recommend hosted-only initially.
Nina S: Ops prefers hosted-only for now. For SI demos we can provide a proxy POC (no weights), or a signed, time-limited runtime under NDA with strict no-redistribute.
legal-bot: Use "hosted-default-v1" template. Include: no redistribution clause, export control paragraph, SI KYC, and optional academic carve-out (non-commercial with attribution).
Jae (marketing): Marketing wants coordinated launch May 20. Need assets by May 6. Also want two SKU options: "Nebula Hosted (API)" and "Nebula Hosted + Proxy POC (NDA)".
Iris V: Action items: Tom draft technical POC approach; Nina set canary/fallback plan; legal to produce addendum; Jae to prep copy once legal OKs.
Tom H: Will draft the proxy flow: container with inference shim that calls Redwood endpoints, no embedded weights, logs anonymized.
Nina S: I'll reserve canary route and plan a 5-day validation.
legal-bot: Reminder: telemetry default to Redwood; partner can opt-in to aggregated metrics.
Iris V: Thanks team  will coordinate timelines and circle back after draft addendum.
